coding.theme: Bioethical and regulatory oversight of clinical trial design
coding.subtheme: FDA placebo-control policy versus international ethical standards

synthesis.main_claim: The FDA should overhaul its practices and prohibit placebo-controlled trials where effective treatments already exist, because current approvals can violate bioethical principles despite FDA reliance on PCTs as the gold standard.
synthesis.contribution: Provides a normative critique of FDA placebo-control policy framed through bioethical principles and international guidelines, useful only as distant contextual background on regulatory oversight in regulated health domains.
synthesis.use_in_review: Foundational contextual only. May briefly inform background discussion of regulatory oversight, ethics, and compliance in regulated sectors, but not eligible as central or supporting evidence on conversational AI or LLM governance.
